correctness.rationale: The general-position set classification was reconstructed from adjacency/geodesic constraints and its coefficient formula independently checked on five small graphs. Initial growth follows from explicit bounds Q4/Q3>=11/2, Q5/Q4>=2 and Q(k+1)/Qk>=1+5/a, while the binomial tail forces the sole criterion c_(a+1)>=c_a. The exact identity c_(a+1)-c_a=a/(a+1)*C(r,a)*(r-R_a+1)-r establishes both sides for every integer a>=5, r>=2a+4. The standalone verifier returned VERIFY_OK. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A published open classification asks which pairs have unimodal general-position polynomials. For every a>=5 in an unbounded two-parameter region, the theorem identifies the exact factorial cutoff separating nonunimodal from unimodal polynomials; both sides occur for each a. This is structural property-level information not supplied by the coefficient enumerator and is not a finite slice or a numerical threshold guess. Other parameter regions remain open.
